storage_illustration.note: Illustrative retained media, not download sizes or a storage permission: disjoint assets across buckets, mono PCM audio and compressed video; excludes text, episode media, decoded frames, cache and checkpoints.

episode.note: Separate live observation pass, bounded inner passes, then outer query passes. First-order P and four-observation F horizon; not a 32-event exact meta-gradient. If implementation merges passes, recount rather than double count.

power.note: Approximate normal paired-binary design at independent source-group level. Re-estimate discordance/cluster variance on development data; continuous metrics require their own design.

audit.note: Additional query variants price P-only, P-reset and wrong-state checks; reuse learned state by cloning it, not reteaching. P updates run in four of eight arms. Same worlds across seeds/orders are clustered, not counted as independent data. Legacy retention and ordinary modality audits are additional.

campaign.note: Reuse each seed's qualified pre-F4 checkpoint only for controls sharing identical upstream training. 20% continuation allowance covers F4 plus consolidation; full factorial retraining, recurrent-core ablations, extra sweeps, policy evolution and failed integrations are additional.
